Two-track witness

Teal lines join uniquely matched events. A true zero is a matched pair at the same tick; unmatched and ambiguous rows never get a zero substituted.

MANIFEST & OUTPUTFIG. 02

Try the three cases

  1. Load Nominal, compare with window 5, and inspect: three +3-tick matches, one missing and one extra event.
  2. Load True zero and compare: a real zero-difference pair.
  3. Load Ambiguous nearest and compare: no invented pair when candidates are tied.

Import accepts only the teaching event-log schema. The exported comparison is an audit result, not an input manifest or controller file.

REFERENCE ATLAS

What the reconstruction establishes

Appearance only

Nominal housing and connectors: 135 × 58 × 21 mm (W × D × H), Doric user manual v1.2.1, table 3.1, p. 14. Depth includes connectors. Fine features and inferred surfaces are not measured.

How pairing works

An event is matched only when each event is the other’s unique nearest candidate within the chosen window, inclusive. Equal-distance ties are ambiguous; competition with a nearer candidate is non-mutual. Differences are observed minus reference, from authored logs only. No hardware signal or device-control model is present.
